topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey, so I just found out about your move to the new department, and wow, that's huge! I mean, it's got to be a bit of a whirlwind, right? But listen, you’ve always been good at adapting, and you’ve got this amazing way of making friends wherever you go. I’m sure you'll ace it, but if you ever need someone to talk to or just want to vent, I'm right here. I just want you to know, this change is going to be okay—more than okay, probably. Your skills and personality are going to shine, mark my words. Let’s catch up soon, yeah? Just to chat. Take care!
